question: PM Modi's honour in Namibia was his which number international award since 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25th**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was conferred with the **Grand Order of the Welwitschia**, which is the highest national award of **Namibia**.

• This prestigious award was presented to him by the President of Namibia, **Nangolo Mbumba**, on the sidelines of the **G20 Summit** held in **Rio de Janeiro**, **Brazil**, in November 2024.

• The **Grand Order of the Welwitschia** marks the **25th international award** bestowed upon PM Modi by various countries and international organizations since he assumed office in **2014**.

• The award recognizes his exceptional leadership, his efforts in fostering strong bilateral ties between **India** and **Namibia**, and his significant contributions to the **Global South**.

**Additional Information__**

• The award is named after **Welwitschia mirabilis**, a rare and ancient plant found only in the **Namib Desert**, which serves as a symbol of resilience and endurance.

• During his November 2024 international visits, PM Modi also received several other top honors, including the **Grand Commander of the Order of the Niger (GCON)** from **Nigeria**, the **Dominica Award of Honour** from **Dominica**, and the **Order of Excellence** from **Guyana**.

• Since 2014, PM Modi has received numerous highest civilian honors from countries across the globe, including the **Order of St. Andrew the Apostle** (Russia), the **Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour** (France), and the **Order of Zayed** (UAE).

• He is the first Indian Prime Minister to be honored with many of these specific international distinctions, reflecting India's growing **diplomatic influence** on the world stage.
